name: Deep Sea Diving & Seabed Trench
summary: Use your Scuba Gear over the deep ocean trench on Brine Road West to submerge beneath the surface into the Deep Sea. Explore the silent sunken trenches, kelp forests, and coral valleys that form the underwater maze leading toward Togepi Island and the Sapphire Cave chasm. Search the seabed to recover two Deep Sea Scales, multiple Heart Scales, and an elusive Shiny Stone resting upon an elevated seafloor ledge.
